In an instant the contents assumed a dull mahogany colour, and a brownish dust was precipitated to the bottom of the glass jar. ha!” he cried, clapping his hands, and looking as delighted as a child with a new toy. “What do you think of that?” “It seems to be a very delicate test,” I remarked.
